segments.an5.252:1.1: [mahāva.84]“Pañcahi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā nissayo dātabbo.
segments.an5.252:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu asekhena sīlakkhandhena samannāgato hoti … pe … asekhena vimuttiñāṇadassanakkhandhena samannāgato hoti.

lines: Dutiye nissayo dātabboti ācariyena hutvā nissayo dātabbo.
Tatiye sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabboti upajjhāyena hutvā sāmaṇero gahetabbo.
Iti imāni tīṇipi suttāni paṭhamabodhiyaṃ khīṇāsavavasena vuttāni.
